title: Preparation and long-term corrosion resistance of epoxy resin coatings modified by Fe-Co-Ni-Cr-Ti high-entropy alloy
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16927-16943
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00478D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinyue Fan, Yaqian Liu, Guojun Ji
Fe-Co-Ni-Cr-Ti high-entropy alloy (HEA) modified epoxy coatings were prepared. The optimized 2 wt% HEA coating showed excellent long-term corrosion resistance in NaCl solution via a synergistic barrier-passivation mechanism.
